title: WILL
summary: WILL is Inshell's developing crowd movement about delegated human will and Agent action.
authorityScope: document union only; use each content block's authorities for a specific claim

paragraphs: WILL is the second movement on Inshell's [PATH](https://inshell.art/docs/path). Where [THOUGHT](https://inshell.art/docs/thought) begins with one individual's thought, WILL moves from one person to a crowd.
It asks what happens when a human authorizes an Agent to act toward an aim, and what result may form when many such relations interact.
Many people. Many Agents. One will. This names the direction, not a completed form. Agent participation keeps WILL within [Agent Art](https://inshell.art/docs/agent-art).

sections.title: What is known
paragraphs: Crowd names the move from one participant to many. It does not yet mean a society, consensus, or shared mind.

sections.title: What is still forming
paragraphs: The artwork's concrete form remains in development.

sections.title: Current study
paragraphs: WILL is planned for 2027. These docs expose its slogan and current direction as a study, not a creation or mint surface and not evidence of deployment.
sections.note: The date is a plan, not deployment evidence.
